title: Pallet Network & Customer Service Coordinator
description:
Are you passionate about delivering excellent customer service while keeping transport operations running smoothly?

We're looking for a Pallet Network & Customer Service Coordinator to join our busy transport team based in Stockport. This is a varied role that combines operational planning with customer relationship management, making it ideal for someone who enjoys problem-solving, building relationships, and working in a fast-paced environment. The role involves coordinating pallet network collections and deliveries, managing customer enquiries, and working closely with drivers and operational teams to ensure an outstanding service is delivered every day.

What You'll Be Doing
- Coordinating daily pallet network collections and deliveries.
- Managing customer bookings and service enquiries.
- Acting as the main point of contact for customers regarding collections, deliveries and service updates.
- Building strong relationships with customers, drivers, and internal teams.
- Monitoring deliveries and proactively resolving any service issues.
- Providing transport quotations and processing customer bookings.
- Maintaining accurate records using transport and customer management systems.
- Supporting key customer accounts and helping to improve customer satisfaction.
- Working collaboratively with transport, warehouse and customer service teams to deliver operational excellence.

What We're Looking For
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise multiple tasks.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving.
- Good IT skills and confidence using business systems.
- The ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues and customers.
- Previous experience within transport, logistics, distribution, customer service or a similar operational environment would be beneficial.

Why Join Us?

At Kinaxia, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to be themselves. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Ready to Apply?

If you're looking for an opportunity where no two days are the same and you can make a real difference to both customers and operations, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of a team that's committed to delivering exceptional service across the UK.

title: RTR Assistant Accountant
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Record to Report Assistant Accountant to join a collaborative and supportive global finance team based in South Manchester This role is perfect for someone who thrives in an environment where accuracy, attention to detail, and continuous improvement are highly valued. As a key member of the record-to-report (R2 R) process team, you will play a vital part in ensuring that financial transactions are processed efficiently and in line with global standards. The organisation offers a welcoming atmosphere where your commitment to quality and your willingness to learn will be recognised and nurtured. With a competitive salary range of £32,000pa-£35,000pa,

As a Record to Report Assistant Accountant, you will immerse yourself in the heart of the organisation's global finance operations. Your daily responsibilities will revolve around executing transactional activities with precision while supporting critical month-end and year-end closing processes. You will be entrusted with upholding data integrity through diligent reconciliations and careful adherence to compliance requirements.

Specific duties include:
- Execute day-to-day transactional activities within the global record-to-report process, ensuring all tasks are completed accurately and efficiently according to established procedures.
- Support both month-end and year-end close activities by preparing reconciliations, processing journal entries, and maintaining data quality throughout the reporting cycle.
- Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and compliance requirements meticulously while escalating any exceptions or discrepancies to senior team members as needed.
- Maintain high standards of data integrity by regularly reviewing financial information for accuracy and completeness, contributing to reliable financial reporting.
- Collaborate closely with stakeholders across different functions and countries to improve service delivery and ensure alignment with global finance standards.
- Handle routine queries from internal teams or external partners promptly and professionally, providing clear explanations or directing more complex issues appropriately.
- Identify inefficiencies within existing processes by monitoring workflows and suggesting practical improvements that enhance overall efficiency.
- Support operational cycles by assisting with ad hoc tasks related to finance operations as required by the wider team or management.

The ideal candidate for the Record to Report Assistant Accountant position brings proven experience from similar roles within global finance environments where attention to detail was crucial. Your background includes exposure to record-to-report cycles, familiarity with ERP platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics F&O (or equivalent), and a solid grasp of fundamental accounting principles. You possess strong organisational capabilities which allow you to juggle competing demands without compromising on quality.

Ideally you will have experience in the following areas:
- Demonstrate experience of 1-3 years working within global record-to-report processes or similar finance roles where accuracy was paramount.
- A basic understanding of core finance processes including reconciliations, journal entries, and compliance requirements gained through previous employment or academic study.
- Familiarity with ERP systems is highly desirable; experience with Microsoft Dynamics F&O would be considered an advantage but is not essential.
- A relevant degree or professional qualification in accounting or finance is preferred though candidates qualified by experience will also be considered.
- Exceptional organisational skills that enable you to manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining high standards of accuracy under tight deadlines.
- A process-driven mindset combined with a proactive attitude towards identifying areas for improvement within established workflows.
- Strong interpersonal skills that allow you to collaborate seamlessly with colleagues from diverse backgrounds both locally and internationally.
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities enabling you to handle queries professionally and document work clearly for audit purposes.

This organisation stands out as a leader in its field thanks to its unwavering commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace where every team member feels valued. Employees benefit from flexible working arrangements designed around their needs alongside generous pension contributions that support long-term security.

If you are ready for your next step in finance within a supportive global team environment, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

title: Sales & Operations Administrator
description:
The Role
We are recruiting for an experienced Sales & Operations Administrator to join a busy and established business.
This is a varied position supporting several areas of the operation, including wholesale customers, contract orders, concessions, retail and warehouse administration.
The role involves working with a significant amount of sales, stock and order data, therefore strong Microsoft Excel skills are essential.
This is not a basic data-entry position. The successful candidate must be comfortable working independently with multiple spreadsheets, reports, calculations and workbooks and be able to pick up existing systems quickly.
Key Duties
Wholesale & Customer Administration
- Answering telephone and email customer enquiries
- Processing customer orders accurately
- Raising invoices using SAGE
- Inputting website and shop sales onto SAGE
- Producing packing lists and associated paperwork
- Managing back orders and monitoring outstanding stock
- Updating customers regarding expected order and delivery dates
- Arranging UK and international freight and deliveries
- Producing FedEx shipping labels
- Assisting with credit control and chasing overdue invoices
- Producing sales and agent reports

Contract & Order Administration
- Producing order forms for the warehouse from customer contracts
- Preparing relevant warehouse and dispatch documentation
- Maintaining forward-order Excel workbooks
- Producing profit and margin calculations for forward orders
- Following individual customer booking-in procedures
- Preparing shipment and incoming stock documentation
- Maintaining accurate records of outstanding and future orders

Concession Administration
- Processing weekly and monthly concession sales information
- Creating barcodes and RRP labels
- Producing packing lists and replenishment sheets
- Booking deliveries and preparing ASN documentation
- Producing seasonal sales information
- Monitoring and organising previous-season returns
- Liaising with concessions regarding seasonal changeovers
- Arranging collections and deliveries

Retail & E-Commerce
- Processing and printing Shopify orders
- Producing Royal Mail and FedEx shipping labels
- Responding to online customer service enquiries
- Processing returns and exchanges
- Maintaining retail pricing documentation
- Producing monthly internet revenue and returns reports
- Providing cover for online order processing when required

General Administration
- Maintaining warehouse logs
- Producing daily out-of-stock reports
- Creating warehouse, stock and product labels
- Updating stock sheets
- Producing customer profit/loss information
- Preparing agent stock, commission and order reports
- Monitoring weekly FedEx costs
- Assisting with brochure mailings
- General administrative support across the office and warehouse operation

Skills & Experience Required
Excellent Microsoft Excel skills are essential.
Candidates must be confident using Excel independently and should be comfortable with:
- Formulas and calculations
- Percentages and margin calculations
- Sorting and filtering
- Working across multiple worksheets and workbooks
- Maintaining existing spreadsheets
- Producing and updating reports
- Manipulating sales, stock and order data
- Checking figures and identifying errors
- Working accurately with large amounts of information

Previous experience using SAGE would be highly desirable.
Experience with Outlook, Word, Shopify, FedEx, Royal Mail or similar systems would also be advantageous.
The successful candidate will be organised, numerate and extremely accurate, with good customer-service skills and the ability to manage several different tasks and priorities throughout the working day.
Please note
This role requires someone with genuinely strong Excel ability who can hit the ground running. Basic Excel knowledge will not be sufficient.

title: Purchasing Administrator
description:
Purchasing Administrator Trafford Park, Manchester Full-Time, Permanent
£32,000-£35,000 + Parking + Benefits

Due to the planned retirement of a long-standing member of the team, we are recruiting for a Purchasing Administrator to join an established international manufacturing business based in Trafford Park.

This is a varied and responsible position sitting at the heart of the purchasing and supply chain process. Working closely with the Inventory Controller, suppliers, Warehouse, Quality, Customer Service and external customs partners, you will help ensure materials are ordered, tracked, documented and received correctly.

THE JOB

Reporting to the Inventory Controller, you will take ownership of the day-to-day purchasing administration, from raising purchase orders and communicating with suppliers through to monitoring international shipments, processing import documentation and booking received materials onto the ERP system.

The role is office-based, working 38hrs per week (including a fully paid lunch break).

Typical working hours are 8am 4.15pm Mon Thurs and 7am 12noon on Fridays.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage the purchasing process, including updating material requirements, raising purchase orders and maintaining regular communication with suppliers regarding orders, availability and delivery dates.
- Coordinate shipping and imports, maintaining relevant documentation, tracking expected arrivals and liaising with customs clearance agents where required.
- Work closely with Warehouse and Quality teams to ensure they have accurate delivery information and supporting documentation, checking incoming goods against purchase orders and updating the ERP system.
- Process supplier invoices and shipping documentation, matching invoices against goods received and providing accurate payment information to Finance.
- Maintain accurate material, purchasing, customs and supply chain records within the ERP system and in line with the company s Quality Management System.
- Manage supplier non-conformances, including communicating issues and arranging credit notes or refunds where appropriate, while providing wider administrative support as required.

THE PERSON

We are looking for a highly organised and proactive administrator who has excellent attention to detail and enjoys working in a busy role where there are multiple orders, deliveries and priorities to manage.

You will need strong administration skills and be comfortable working with purchase orders, invoices, delivery information and computerised systems. Experience using an ERP system would be beneficial, although the ability and willingness to learn new systems quickly are equally important.

As you will be communicating with suppliers and working closely with several internal departments and external partners, you should be a confident and professional communicator who is comfortable following issues through to resolution.

Previous experience within purchasing, procurement administration, supply chain, materials or a similar environment would be advantageous.

Experience of international shipping, import documentation or customs processes would also be particularly beneficial, although training can be provided where appropriate.

Above all, we are looking for someone who understands the importance of accurate information and timely purchasing and who can build strong working relationships across the wider supply chain.

THE BENEFITS
- £32,000 - £35,000 Salary (depending on experience)
- Free onsite parking
- Company pension
- Life Insurance
- 25.5 days holiday + Bank holidays
- Full-time, permanent position
- Opportunity to join a stable and established international manufacturing business
- Comprehensive training and support provided
- Opportunity to develop experience across purchasing, supply chain, imports and customs administration

Please note that we are only able to consider applications from those who are eligible to work in the UK and therefore do not require sponsorship.
